headline: How long does a soulmate keep you waiting?
note:
FRAME: soulmate x age band. NO MAN EXISTS YET — she asks WHEN or WHETHER. Must not fall through to decode-him, which would have Evelyn invent a man.
🔴 THE AGE BAND LIVES IN THE AD SET, NEVER IN THE COPY. No age, no number, no life-stage, nothing she could check.
🔴 NO DURATION, forward or back. Every frame bans a DATE; this family's own gap was that 'not much longer' is a LENGTH, and a length is not a date. Nothing here gives one.
⚠ SHE is the subject of beats 3-6; the male figure is described in beats 1-2 and retired there.
⚠ NO FAMILY-LINE LANGUAGE anywhere in the read.

🔴 SHE ASKS FOR A LENGTH AND THERE IS NONE TO GIVE. The read answers the SHAPE of the question instead: no length was ever set, so the number she wants does not exist. That is the honest answer and it is also the only permitted one.

readback.1 would a person say this: Yes. 'And it's gone on a good while' is spoken, and it is her own premise, not a measurement.
readback.2 is every noun real: Working hands, calm face, mid-step feet — all on the card.
readback.3 anything she could catch me getting wr: No. Beat 4 says nobody has come and she has had no answer. Neither is a count.
readback.4 does the symbol prove the line at a gl: Yes. Two hands working and neither idle proves 'nothing's stalling' at a glance.

a: You turned the Magician. You reached blind, and your hand found the one who came ready.
Look at his table. Four things laid out, and every one in reach.
You asked how long a soulmate keeps you waiting. What catches me is that all of it is already to hand.
And yet nobody has come. And the waiting is what you're asking me to measure.
Something stands between you and this, close in. I don't think any of it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's standing there…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. Face down, all three, and yours was the one still growing.
Look at the wood he hangs from. Green leaves are on it, and it's alive.
You asked how long a soulmate keeps you waiting. It's a pause with life still in it, and that's what stops me.
Nobody has come, though. And how long is the whole of your question.
The hold is steady, and it hasn't slackened. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's got hold of it…
c: You turned the Fool. Nothing told them apart, and you took the only one in full sun.
Look at the sky behind him. Gold, and not one cloud in it.
You asked how long a soulmate keeps you waiting. A bright day, and the walking already begun.
But nobody has come. And you're the one asking how long.
Something comes in at the moment this would move. I don't think this began with you.
Let me look closer at what this is…
